Vaizatha@Est.9.9.description: Vaizatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, the enemy of the Jews.
Vaizatha@Est.9.9.name: Vaizatha

Valley_Gate@2Ch.26.9-Neh.description: The Valley Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and mentioned in connection with King Uzziah's fortifications (<ref="2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13">2Chr. 26:9; Neh. 2:13, 15; 3:13</ref>).
Valley_Gate@2Ch.26.9-Neh.name: Valley_Gate

Vaniah@Ezr.10.36.description: Vaniah was an Israelite who had married a foreign wife during the Exile.
Vaniah@Ezr.10.36.name: Vaniah

Vashti@Est.1.9-.description: Vashti, queen of Persia, was deposed by King Ahasuerus for disobeying his command.
Vashti@Est.1.9-.name: Vashti

Vedan@Ezk.27.19.description: Vedan, a place of uncertain location, mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy as trading with Tyre (<ref="Ezek. 27:19">Ezek. 27:19</ref>).
Vedan@Ezk.27.19.name: Vedan

Vophsi@Num.13.14.description: Vophsi was the father of Nahbi, the man chosen to represent the tribe of Naphtali as a spy.
Vophsi@Num.13.14.name: Vophsi
